conditions: An element's declared DTD content model uses a sequence list of content particles.
limitations: Occurrence modifiers and choices govern which occurrences match. This is a DTD validity rule scoped to a sequence model.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: In an XML 1.0 Fifth Edition element-content sequence model, content particles must match in their declared order.
